extensionDescription.message: Makes Firefox wear a mask to look like Chrome to websites that otherwise won't work.

breakageWarning.message: While Chrome Mask may help if you see a "Browser unsupported" message, it could cause unexpected breakage on some sites.

reportBrokenSite.message: If you find a site which works better with Chrome Mask enabled, please report it $IN_PRODUCT_REPORTER$ or $WEBCOMPAT$. Thank you! ♥

maskStatusOn.message: The mask is on! I pretend to be Chrome on this site.

maskStatusOff.message: The mask is off. I look like Firefox to this site.

maskStatusUnsupported.message: The mask cannot work on this site.

maskStatusBlocked.message: Chrome Mask cannot be enabled on this site.

blockedExplanation.message: This site is not blocking Firefox and is known to break when Chrome Mask is enabled. $READ_MORE_LINK$.

blocklistSectionStatus.message: The domain blocklist is currently disabled. Sites on the blocklist can be masked. DO NOT file bug reports or leave bad reviews for sites on the blocklist.

preferencesFallback.message: To adjust preferences, please open the Extension Manager, select Chrome Mask, and hit Settings.

addSiteHostnameExplanation.message: Note: Always enter the full domain name. If you enter example.com, Chrome Mask will not be active on www.example.com!

addSiteErrorBlocked.message: Chrome Mask cannot be enabled for this domain!

blocklistDisabledNotice.message: The domain blocklist is now disabled.

blocklistEnabledNotice.message: The domain blocklist is now enabled.

addSiteErrorAlreadyActive.message: Chrome Mask is already enabled for this domain!

siteListEmpty.message: You did not enable Chrome Mask on any site yet!

manageSitesClearConfirmation.message: Do you want to remove all masked sites?

shortcutsToggleMask.message: Toggle the mask for the current site
